## Greatsword Barbarian (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 Male human barbarian 4  
 CG Medium humanoid (human)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **hp** 67 (4d12+20)  
 **Fort** +8, **Ref** +3, **Will** +5  
 **Defensive Abilities** trap sense +1, uncanny dodge  

**Offense**
